_README: Futr Markets — site configuration. Edit this file directly on the server; no rebuild is needed. Reload the page to see changes. Keep it valid JSON: every value in double quotes, no trailing commas.

contact._endpoint: The URL enquiries are POSTed to. For 'sheets' this is the Google Apps Script /exec URL. Leave empty for 'web3forms'.
contact._accessKey: Only used by 'web3forms'. Leave empty otherwise.
